svg.title: Puzzle Forge Jigsaw connector family atlas
svg.desc: High-fidelity specimens generated from the connector geometry used by Puzzle Forge. Each family shows a representative tab, its matching blank, and left, centered, and right-biased seeded variants.
svg.text: Representative tab + matching blank + seeded left / centered / right variants. Geometry is derived from the actual connector definitions.
Nominal edge baseline is dashed. Tab/blank polarity changes direction, not family identity.

g.text: Narrow neck under a broad overhanging cap
Thin stem opening into a compact round head
Narrow stem ending in a horizontal crossbar
Long neck flowing into an offset rounded body
Asymmetric rounded body with a pointed tip
Broad sweep interrupted by a deep inward scoop
Serpentine seam that crosses the edge baseline
Narrow stem flaring into a pointed head
